claims.statement: scripts/create_evidence_receipt.py can now emit the correction instrument it was extended to emit. VERIFIED at this commit: --evidence-path and --verification-command are optional and enforced by status, so a zero-diff retraction generates and validates while a verified receipt missing either flag fails with an error naming it; claim_type is derived from status rather than hardcoded to evidence. VERIFIED: 183 tests pass under Python 3.12 and scripts/validate.sh reports all executed checks passed. The defect was the same shape as the one the previous commit fixed: the instrument existed in the schema and the validator accepted it, and only the generator's required arguments made it unreachable, which is why the single prior correction in .quirk/evidence had to be hand-written. UNKNOWN: whether any other generator argument is mandatory for a case the validator permits; only the two reached by the correction path were audited.

commands.command: uv run --no-project --python 3.12 python -m unittest discover -s tests
